source.harnessChange: main selectFixture waits for the new DOMContentLoaded; not the same harness as d2c/R2

verification.head: 5852aa8832c07fdeef43665dd5e156ce5516e3ea
verification.scope: all actual pg.Client.query calls and PostgreSQL protocol bytes in the primary API process; no sampling
exclusions: test-account lease/session tracking and fixture SQL in the separate harness process
PostgreSQL connection handshake and TCP/TLS overhead
verification.background: all concurrent primary API background traffic is included; no guessed subtraction or per-request attribution
verification.boundary: query calls started and protocol bytes transferred by each checkpoint; in-flight response bytes can cross a checkpoint

login.authentication: normal email sign-in and get-session through the original leased-account helper; freshly saved private storageState
login.native: the same email authentication, then real PKCE with the authenticated browser session and initial renderer/workspace selection
login.web: the same email authentication, then a new actual Chromium context and the same workspace selection
login.sessionCache: normal signed-cookie cache, no manual flush; cache hits are not measured
login.comparisonBasis: common ordinary authentication and same usable workspace; native includes its additional PKCE transport
login.order: short Web context closes first; native and hosted retain the final ordinary login through the unchanged lifecycle checks
login.protocolPhases: native handoff overlaps automatic renderer navigation; these concurrent queries are not falsely separated
login.accountAndWorkspace: same leased owner and existing seeded fixture

startup.samples: first pair only from the unchanged five-pair lifecycle sequence
startup.clients: bundled Electron and the preserved hosted Web renderer in the same compiled Electron shell
startup.sessionCache: same retained authenticated app profile/workspace; normal profile and OS caches, no purge
startup.backend: same primary API and fixed source; server is already warm

excludedDesktopOnly: data-desktop-only: server row, Settings › 服务器

checks.name: packaged local origin and isolated renderer
local document CSP blocks external renderer fetches
server choice: probe states, probed-only selection, the page follows the chosen server and returns
system browser shows the signed-in account, then loopback and single-use PKCE session handoff
the callback page opens the Dev build's own app link
opening the app link brings the packaged app to the front
no browser session credential in renderer-accessible state
native badge, payload validation, device and quota bridge
settings deep link and shared devices page

cleanupBoundaries.postgresStatement: The unmodified formal workflow starts local PostgreSQL but emits no explicit stop/probe receipt; no separate PG stop is claimed.
cleanupBoundaries.extractionVMCleanup: Separate exact stop/delete/GET404 receipt in terminal index

limitations: FIRST is the original pair-1 query count, not a claim that all startup performance measures passed.
Bundled FIRST has original cross-end calls, and all unknown attribution is preserved without deduction.
Daemon 0.0.567 and main-derived harness changes prevent assigning all inter-run changes to the task-run visibility fix.
No Native parity PNG pixel viewing by this agent; parity assessment uses the preserved original report and numeric consistency checks.
This is pre-production Native evidence; production acceptance remains 0/2.
